text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While Ines Fujin's coworkers aren't<n>especially
familiar with the world of<n>racing, they're still
surprised to hear<n>that she plans to compete in the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But they've seen Ines Fujin working<n>hard
first-hand, and this is her dream.<n>Knowing full well
how much effort<n>she puts in, they root for her with
all<n>they have.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan—the hope of<n>her
prestigious family—finds herself<n>the subject of
great expectations. It<n>sounds like she's being
touted as the<n>favorite to win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While greatness is expected from<n>both, Mejiro
Ryan has conflicting<n>feelings when she sees just
how<n>focused Ines Fujin is.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Mejiro Ryan plans to<n>come and
observe the Asahi Hai F.S.<n>Excited to learn that her
friend will be<n>in attendance, Ines Fujin feels
massively motivated.
